description: Build the new film components and nine scenes, assemble them into the BrandFilm composition, register it additively in Root.tsx, and add the render:film script. This is the cinematic film itself (CINEMATIC-FILM.md §3.2-3.4, §5, §9, §10, build order §14 steps 7-8). Prioritize the client's 'make it a movie' bar: let shots breathe, vary rhythm, the turn at f1140 must be felt, finale holds like a film's last frame. Depends on FEAT-003.
steps: components/film/FootageClip.tsx: the ONLY footage renderer. Render <OffthreadVideo src={staticFile(meta.file)} trimBefore={meta.inPoint}> (length from durationInFrames/Sequence; do NOT use deprecated trimAfter/startFrom/endAt). Mirror ImageReveal discipline: uniform objectFit:'cover' + objectPosition from focal point; Ken-Burns via kenBurns(frame,[startFrame,startFrame+durationInFrames],{fromScale,toScale,panX,panY,easing:EASE.inOut}) spanning the shot's OWN window (default 1.06->1.10); clamp 0.08; grade via CSS filter from filmGrade (cool/warm) + GradeLayer veil; two-layer bottom scrim from GRADE.scrim. NO skew/stretch API. Support an optional MaskKind reusing ImageReveal's wipe set. Allow a 'static' mode (fromScale===toScale) so some shots do not move.

components/film/GradeLayer.tsx: animated grade veil warming gradeCool->gradeWarm over 1140->1500 then held warm, using filmGrade presets. At most one amber element per frame — the amber veil is atmospheric, capped at a restrained opacity, never a glow/gradient.

components/film/Caption.tsx: minimal on-screen copy. Delegate the ENTRANCE reveal to AnimatedText (reveal-only, no exit). Caption OWNS the hold + fade-out via its own outer opacity interpolation over [in0,in1,out0,out1] using the §5 storyboard fade windows (e.g. 'fade in 162->188, out 348->378'). Large type, generous air, long holds; support a title + mono sub-label layout for the capability captions C5-C7.

components/film/Narration.tsx: mount each NARRATION entry as <Audio src={staticFile(entry.file)}/> inside <Sequence from={entry.startFrame} durationInFrames={entry.durationInFrames}> (single-line MP3s, no in-point trim).

components/film/MusicBed.tsx: two <Audio> tracks with volume automation from filmMusic — Track A clipN(f,[0,60,1020,1080,1140,1200],[0,0.9,0.9,0.3,0.3,0]), Track B clipN(f,[1140,1200,2520,2700],[0,0.85,0.85,0.0]) — equal-power cross-fade at 1140-1200. Apply VO ducking: import NARRATION and multiply the active track's base volume by DUCK=0.45 across [start-6,start,end,end+12] per entry (compose by taking the min factor across overlapping VO windows), clamped to [0,1].

scenes/film/ (nine files, 1:1 with ranges): Film01_Struggle, Film02_Friction, Film02b_Weight, Film03_Turn, Film05_BuildSoftware, Film06_BuildInfra, Film07_BuildControl, Film08_Resolution, Film09_Lockup. Author each exactly per the §5 shot-by-shot table (clip ids/local files, moves incl. the explicit static holds on 1.1 and 2b.2, copy captions with their fade windows, grade cool->warm). Film03_Turn (1140-1620) is ONE unbroken 16s emotional move where light enters and the partner is named by vo06 — this is the money moment, make it land. Film09_Lockup (2412-2700, 288f, no footage) uses LogoReveal speed='fast' + AnimatedText/Caption over COLOR.ink with the four sign-off beats (9.1 Built with intention., 9.2 the vision line, 9.3 Small enough to care., 9.4 Technical enough to build.) each held >=48f/1.6s, BrandMark fully assembled on frame 2700, wordmark LUMEN LABS + mono SOUTH AFRICAN TECHNOLOGY STUDIO. Capability captions C5-C7 render the title + the filmCopy join sub-labels (C7 includes SCADA).

src/BrandFilm.tsx: a <Series> (or <AbsoluteFill> with sequenced scenes) composing the nine scenes at their FILM_SCENES ranges, wrapping everything in FormatContext.Provider value={format} and the font-gate/delayRender pattern used by LaunchFilm.tsx, with GradeLayer, Narration, MusicBed, and Grain layered globally. Reuse the existing LaunchFilm.tsx structure for the font load gate — study it, do not edit it.

src/Root.tsx: append EXACTLY ONE <Composition id="BrandFilm" component={BrandFilm} durationInFrames={FILM_DURATION} fps={30} width={FORMATS.wide.width} height={FORMATS.wide.height} defaultProps={{ format: FORMATS.wide }} />. Leave the three LaunchFilm-* entries byte-for-byte unchanged.
package.json: add exactly ONE new script "render:film": "remotion render BrandFilm out/lumen-labs-brand-film.mp4". Do NOT change existing scripts.

Run typecheck + full test suite (neutral config) — all green, existing copy snapshot untouched. Render a quick still at f0 and f2699 to confirm the composition mounts (full render is FEAT-005). Commit on feat/cinematic-brand-film (e.g. 'feat(ad): cinematic brand film components, scenes, composition + render script'). Do NOT push.
acceptance_criteria: All five new components under src/components/film/ and all nine scenes under src/scenes/film/ exist and typecheck.
Footage is rendered ONLY via FootageClip using OffthreadVideo + trimBefore (no deprecated trimAfter/startFrom/endAt); some shots are intentionally static.

BrandFilm.tsx composes the nine scenes at the FILM_SCENES ranges with GradeLayer/Narration/MusicBed/Grain and the font gate; the turn at f1140 (music cross-fade + grade warm + vo06) is implemented as one deliberate shift.
Root.tsx has exactly one added BrandFilm composition (1920x1080@30, FILM_DURATION frames); the three LaunchFilm-* entries are unchanged.
package.json has the new render:film script and no changes to existing scripts.
`node "$NPM" run typecheck` zero-error; full ad test suite green (existing copy snapshot unchanged); a still renders at f0 and f2699; a commit exists on feat/cinematic-brand-film.
verification: node "$NPM" exec -- remotion still BrandFilm out/_probe/f0.png --frame=0
node "$NPM" exec -- remotion still BrandFilm out/_probe/f2699.png --frame=2699

findings.summary: Authored the 8 remaining scenes (Film02 Friction, Film02b Weight, Film03 Turn, Film05 Software, Film06 Infra, Film07 Control+Security, Film08 Resolution, Film09 Lockup), BrandFilm.tsx (Series + font gate + global GradeLayer/Narration/MusicBed/Grain), appended one BrandFilm Composition to Root.tsx, and added the render:film script. Film01 and all 5 film components + config were already on disk from the interrupted pass and reused as-is. typecheck zero-error; 55/55 tests green; copy snapshot unchanged.
findings.scenes_detail: All scenes use scene-local frames inside Series.Sequence. Captions use the §5 fade windows converted to scene-local. C7 renders FILM_COPY.controlLine = COPY.s04.control.items.join(' · ') which includes SCADA. Film09 lockup uses LOCKUP_BEATS from filmTimeline.ts converted to scene-local, LogoReveal speed='fast' assembling under 9.3-9.4 and held fully assembled on frame 2700; wordmark LUMEN LABS + mono SOUTH AFRICAN TECHNOLOGY STUDIO.
findings.deviations: (1) Film03 shot 3.1 originally had a wipeLR mask which made the turn frame (f1140) render black at the cut; removed the mask so f1140 lands on the warm meeting footage (the shift is carried by grade warm-up + music cross-fade + push-in). (2) Film09 b4 caption fade-out finishes ~6f before 2700 (via out1-16/out1-6) so the final frame is a clean lockup with no lingering caption; full-opacity hold unchanged. Neither changes config or the tested invariants.
findings.env_blocker_resolved: Remotion 4.0.533 gnu compositor requires GLIBC_2.35 but host (Amazon Linux 2023) has glibc 2.34 -> any OffthreadVideo frame aborted. Resolved WITHOUT touching app/Remotion code: scripts/setup-render-binaries.sh assembles a binaries dir with the unmodified gnu compositor + gnu ffmpeg/ffprobe, with the compositor run under a fetched glibc-2.35 loader (Ubuntu 22.04 libc6) via --library-path. render:film passes it with --binaries-directory. The fetched loader lives under node_modules (gitignored); no binaries committed. The bundled musl compositor was tried first but segfaults (its libav*.so need a musl userland).
